name: Green algae and desmids
description: Green algae, including the often ornate desmids. Functional group pooling six source taxa - Arthrodesmus sp., Closteriopsis longissimus, Dictyosphaerium pulchellum, Selenastrum minutum, Spinocosmarium sp. and Staurastrum sp. - following the major phytoplankton classes used by the limnological literature.
